app.name: Author
app.title: Documentation Author
app.slogan: Create exciting educational content using Electra Academy.
app.description:
With Documentation Author, you can easily create and share documents, worksheets, and course materials online. You can add circuits, math formulas, cloze, pictures, and more to your documents, making them more engaging and informative. Sharing your work with others has never been easier.

I hope you'll give it a try!

empty.description: Start by adding your first content to make it feel more alive in here!

image.dragdrop: Drag & Drop image or click to upload

dialog.promote_explain: Make your version the group's version? Everyone who sees this document under the same "Provided by" group will then get your changes.
dialog.promote_description_label: Note for the reviewers (optional) - what changed and why?
dialog.revert_explain: Discard your personal changes and show the official version again? This cannot be undone.
dialog.delete_explain: Delete this document? There is no group version to fall back to - this cannot be undone.
dialog.delete_shared_explain: Delete this document for the whole group? It disappears for everyone who sees it here, and this cannot be undone.
dialog.delete_shared_request_explain: Request deletion of this document? Your group's reviewers must approve it before it is removed for everyone.
dialog.open_conflict_explain: You have a personal copy of this document. Open your own copy, or the group's version?
dialog.distribute_explain: You send your version into other workspaces you belong to. If a workspace has review enabled, it's checked there first - otherwise it becomes visible right away to everyone in that workspace and the ones below it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.intro: What has happened across your workspaces - the outcome of your drafts, review requests waiting for you, and your own approvals.

event.delete_requested: {{actor}} asks you to review the deletion of {{subject}} in {{scope}}
event.i_withdrew: You withdrew the request for {{subject}} in {{scope}}

review.title: Review
review.intro: Documents waiting for your approval. You vote with the reviewer points the workspace admin granted you; a document is committed once the approving points reach the workspace's threshold. A single reject closes the request.
review.deletion_notice: This document is proposed for deletion - approving removes it for everyone here.
review.my_points_hint: Your vote adds this many points
review.withdraw_explain: Withdraw this request? It will be removed as if you never submitted it.
review.not_open: This review is no longer open
review.load_failed: Could not load the review document
review.no_change_comment: No change comment - the author did not describe what changed.
review.reject_explain: Rejecting immediately closes this review request. The author must revise the document and submit it for review again.
review.accept_explain: As an admin you can commit this document immediately, overriding the review threshold. Continue?
review.instruction_reviewer: The author of this document kindly asks for your approval. Once enough people accept it, the document goes public and everyone in the workspace benefits from the change or new document.
review.instruction_admin: As an admin of this workspace, you can accept it immediately.
review.instruction_voted: Thank you - you have already accepted this change. Once enough people accept this changed document, it can go public.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.intro: A workspace is a common space for a team or class - add the people who belong, and everything you promote reaches only them. Members work inside it, admins manage people and the review settings, and reviewers hold the points that approve changes. Changes can pass through review first, so nothing reaches your team, or the public, before it's ready. And it all nests hierarchically - from a single group to a whole organization. Open one to explore, or create your own and invite others.
workspaces.create_needs_parent: Open a workspace first, then create a sub-workspace inside it.
workspaces.required_score_hint: Approval points a document must collect before it commits in this workspace. 0 = no review.

draft.title: My Documents
draft.intro: Your private documents and your personal versions of shared ones. When you edit and save a shared document, your changes land here - nobody else sees them. Want your version to reach others? Promote it to propose it as your group's version, or Distribute it into other workspaces you belong to. Where a workspace requires review, it is checked and approved there first.
draft.review_points_explain: {{have}} of {{need}} approval points collected. Once the threshold is reached the document is committed as the public version.
draft.kind_personal_explain: This document exists only in your personal workspace - nobody else can see it.
draft.kind_personal_copy_explain: You have a personal version of a shared document. Promote your changes to submit them for review - once approved they become your group's version.

files.title: Shared Documents
files.intro: The documents available to you across your groups. Open one to use it; editing and saving creates your own copy (see My Files) without touching the original.
